items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest); misses min 4 weeks. Signed Velus Jones.
Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip issue; expected to play though snaps may be limited.

items.text: Breece Hall and De'Von Achane OUT (Achane longer-term).
Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) downgraded to OUT vs Commanders.
Excellent spot for Nico Collins return: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison moment: home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out.
Eagles situation worse: without Smith, Goedert, Baun vs Rams.
Tough run for Jadarian Price: lost GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing; still eye-test positive long-term.
LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ to RBs every game.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches, RB5 util; NYG allows 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS w/ Penix, vs NO) and Garrett Wilson (no Mitchell, 36% prior TS vs CHI).
